body: "I’ve been using Me+ to help structure my day, and it is easily one of the most aesthetically pleasing and intuitive routine planners I’ve tried. The app does a fantastic job of breaking down overwhelming tasks into manageable habits, making it especially helpful for anyone dealing with ADHD or executive dysfunction who needs that extra 'nudge' to stay on track. While the customization options and mood-tracking features are top-notch, the aggressive paywall for the VIP version can be a bit frustrating for those on a budget. Overall, if you’re looking for a beautiful, all-in-one space to gamify your self-care and productivity, Me+ is definitely worth the download."

El problema es que el genero no cambia tu fisiologia que hace que necesites una tal cantidad de agua, si no que lo es el sexo. title: great idea but execution…
body:
My chores are always in the wrong order no matter how often I rearrange them. My evening chores come before the morning chores, which is annoying and i don’t see a way to fix it on my side.
Some feedback: Being a women it would be nice to have something around cycle health. A lot of women do specific things depending on where they are in their cycle e.g no work out on period days, a clean-up in the luteal phase… I decided I don’t want to pay for an organizer app if the biggest influence on female organization is not thought of. A booty workout suggestion is just not enough to check the „thought of women“ box.

title: Little expectations but a game changer
body:
Undiagnosed ADHD sufferer trying to get organised. Being able to pick routines that I want to do with my day (such as face care, kitchen clean etc) without too much brain investment is just what I need. Also it doesn’t bully you into doing your tasks which I like. I would prefer it if you could set a monthly day to do tasks as well as a date eg first Saturday of the month to do a task rather that “repeats every 21st” but that’s ok, I can reschedule it if need be. Nifty little app and unlike others meant to manage ADHD it wasn’t a horrendously expensive monthly price.
UPDATE. Rarely use it. I guess it’s a novelty factor. Also when I did try to use it and was moving tasks not completed to the next day, I noticed rows of 6 not 7 numbers, the days of the week not lining up. Come on! I have enough problem with this without your software fiddling it too

title: A great app!
body:
Things I like,
Me+ is a great app, it can help you track your sleep, your daily routine and more! I especially love the 100 ways to love yourself, it can provide me with great things to do everything. I also love the fact that there is meditation, I’m someone who struggles to stay calm so this helps! 

Things I don’t like,
Though this app may be some way to make your life healthier, it’s hard to keep up with everything. Drink 2100ML of water daily is almost impossible to me since most of the time I don’t even know how much water I’ve drank! And for the younger kids using this app 2000 water (not even minimum) is way too much water. Secondly, most of the time I’m using this app everything you need is money, as someone who wants a app with less ‘subscribing’ this app has way too much of spending money. Also the notifications. Everyday I set the notification for somethings, but the app is constantly sending me stupid notifications, this annoys me especially when I’ve had a bad day from school and came back to text or watch YouTube, every few minutes there are notifications ringing.

title: Predatory, Scarcity Marketing & Spamming
body:
I really wanted to like this app—it has numerous features that seem helpful on the surface and I like multipurpose applications—but I didn’t because the logic behind it is ugly

The initial quiz is used unethically to benefit their pockets and not the user. For example, they rely heavily on scarcity marketing tactics like countdown timers and limited time offers, with numerous stimulating flashy pop-ups and notifications. These tactics are documented to disproportionately impact neurodivergent people, so using these tactics is gross. Additionally, their notification SPAM was so great that it has sent me more notifications than any other non-messaging app.

I know this app has good marketing and is within a crowded market that’s hard to navigate, but please do not reward them with your time, attention or money.

title: Update dilemma
body:
What I like. 
- love that I can now set things in the future. Grey for setting up events and things that happen in the future like things for the kids related to school and my work as a teacher. 
- love the ability to set a time frame. It’s great to be able to set times to do things so I’m not trying to figure out what to do next.  Relieves some of the cognitive load and executive dysfunction related to ADHD. 
-the new images/icons are great but not necessarily a needed update. 

What I miss. 

-timers and number of times features related to tasks. A 20-tidy task now involves the extra step of opening a new app for a timer. Without it, there is another layer to completing a task I don't need. 
- the description under the task name. I used this to write why the task is important or a motivational quote to know my why. To open the app after my auto update to see this as part of my subset was a challenge and time-consuming to either remove or mark off to complete the task. 

I found the app trying to find something to improve my habits that worked with my ADHD because the stress is not helping me get my ADHD under control. These small things leaving could mean having to find a new app or continually fighting myself to stay motivated.

title: Promotes shame and disordered eating behaviours
body:
The whole app focuses on shaming your current self, which isn’t a very sustainable way to change your habits to healthy, lasting ones. 

There is too much of a focus on weight loss, rather than on healthy behaviours (which may mean you happen to lose weight). It also gives some disordered eating advice like “being a little hungry is the best thing that can happen to you.” This isn’t true - if you want to eat sustainably and healthily, you should nourish yourself and feel satisfied. It also suggests only having black coffee or tea because these are appetite suppressants. Again, having black coffee/tea isn’t a satisfying, and diverse meal. It’s way healthier to have food that actually satisfies you and is nutritious. Also it’s ok to have some milk with your tea, it tastes nicer (plus adds protein)

Also shaming yourself around eating junk food can lend towards a cycle of restriction and binging. Instead, giving yourself permission to eat junk food, while also being guided by gentle nutrition and how your body feels is much healither way. Look up into intuitive eating for more advice

title: Great concept, could use improvement in areas.
body:
The app is great but I found it quite overwhelming at first. The discover area where you could just add specific things, I thought was great but then it became too much trying to adjust and customise everything that I had to just delete it all (which also was confusing). 

I think an area where you can see ALL of your habits, ALL of your DELETED habits, and REMOVED habits would be great! As a good reference point, as well as a good place to delete any habits you aren’t happy with.

The “goal” feature is a bit difficult because (for example) it doesn’t have the option of “L” or “drinks” for a habit like “Drink Water”. Or perhaps for habits you only want to accomplish at least 3x a month? 

It would be great if it included a “Goal” in terms of how many times you would like to achieve this habit in a month. But maybe that’s just me? 

I ended up deleting everything and starting from scratch, creating my own tags and colours and habits. The app glitched ALOT during this and I kept having to close and re-open, but I got there in the end :) It’s great being able to tick things off. Although, I don’t understand why my day on the calendar becomes a silver medal? And I also got what looked like a baby chick and “3x” or something pop up? As a reward??? Idk. More explanation would be great.

title: Jouw Complete Dagelijkse Gids voor Planning en Welzijn
body: Als iemand die altijd op zoek is naar manieren om mijn dag te structureren en mijn mentale welzijn te verbeteren, heeft de 'me+'-app werkelijk mijn verwachtingen overtroffen. De mogelijkheid om mijn hele dag te plannen, van taken tot ontspanningsmomenten, heeft mijn productiviteit aanzienlijk verhoogd. Wat deze app echt onderscheidt, is de aandacht voor mijn mentale gezondheid. De ingebouwde tools voor mindfulness, stressvermindering en persoonlijke groei zijn ronduit geweldig. Het feit dat deze app volledig gratis is, maakt het een onmisbare metgezel voor iedereen die op zoek is naar een holistische benadering van welzijn. Een absolute aanrader voor iedereen die zijn leven in eigen hand wil nemen en daarbij een beetje digitale ondersteuning kan gebruiken.

title: Muito bom, mas pode melhorar!
body: Aplicativo muito bom, mas podia melhorar. A função de timer não funciona bem quando sai do aplicativo, normalmente em outros apps continua a contagem na barra de notificações, nesse não. Aí as vezes quando preciso voltar, a contagem sumiu, fico sem saber quanto tempo fiz. Outra coisa que me incomoda é que não da pra conectar o tempo diretamente a uma tarefa, queria que pudesse, e queria também que além da função de pomodoro ou da escolha de tempo contando de cima pra baixo, tivesse uma opção que começasse do 0, e fosse contando até a gente pausar ou finalizar. Pra mim, se tivesse essas opções, o app seria perfeito.

title: The app is good, but need changes
body:
Hello, my name is Isabel, and I’ve been using this app since July. I have ADHD, and it helped me to maintain a healthy routine. However, there are a few things that need improvement. 

The app should have a dark mode option, especially for easier use at night. Another issue is the subscription options: I’d like to make a monthly subscription, but currently only a yearly plan is available. Also, when I go to the “Redeem Offers” option, it asks for a code that I don’t have or know how to get.

The app is good, but it really needs these changes.

title: Worst habit tracker app I’ve seen
body:
So, the only pro I can see is the design. The app looks really pleasant. 

But the functions… most are useless, so little is made. 
I can’t see all of my habits at one place. (Well, in profile I can see a list, but I can’t do ANYTHING with it)
I can’t delete any habits except for the today’s ones. 
When I accidentally tap that I want to add something to my routine, I can’t delete it. 
I have to edit every habit manually, after browsing for it for ages. 

When you first see all the good-looking routines, you always add too many. But there is no convenient tool to edit that => even more procrastination. 

I don’t like paper planners, but they have much more options and scenarios than Me+. Regret every cent I’ve spent on the subscription.

title: Amazing App, Lots of Potential, A Few Suggestions
body:
Super cool app. Love the design and simplicity. Keeps me motivated. It is reasonable with what is free and what cost money. They don’t try to scam!! Love love LOVE that there’s no longer a limit on how many tasks I can do at once. Love the other pages as well, super helpful! Some ideas I thought would be fun and thought the creators might think so too:

-A friend system that you can add each other and see each others progress/remind them to complete tasks.(would help promote the app by encouraging people to share it)

-The ability to delete tags, I like to organize everything (if you already can, I can’t find it lol)

-More health tasks in the top as well as water (protein intake, carbs, steps), would love to see all of my goals in one app to keep me on track lol

-More colours for tasks (maybe a colour wheel so people can make their own)/making cute themes available for tasks so it can be more aesthetic 

-More emojis for tasks (there’s a lot of food and not a lot of cleaning symbols lol)

-An upgrade to the tag system so habits are more differentiated and organized. Like the heath tasks bar. Could make a morning routine, night routine, daily cleaning routine etc 
+
An area to quickly and simply write things that only need to be done that day or within the week, similar to a To-Do list. Like as if separating the current system into long-term (routines that are planned ahead and repeated regularly) and short-term (one time tasks that need to be completed that day or within the week) instead of having it all in one spot

-The ability to swipe from page to page instead of clicking on the icons (would encourage more use)

-An earning system. Every task or routine a person completes, they get exp and/or coins. The exp can go towards a level system that increases with exp and the coins can be used to temporarily buy premium perks (again, encouraging more use/giving customers a better idea on the perks of premium aka encouraging more people to buy)

-An upgrade to the widget bar that will show what tasks need to be done in that moment instead of in general, as well as replacing the tasks that are completed with ones incompleted

-Maybe an option for something similar to the Apple calendar format where you visually see where you blocked out specific times for which task or routine


Sorry for the whole essay but I see a lot of potential in this app. As a person with ADHD, these suggestions are things that I find make apps highly addictive and encourage me to use them consistently. And if any app should be addictive, it should be the ones that benefit you such as Me+🩷✨

title: Beware No “FREE” trial
body: I was looking into Me+ and wanted a one month subscription. Then a one year subscription with a “one week free trial” was offered at a good price, so I chose that option. Within the hour, I changed my mind and went to cancel my new subscription, as one can do with any “free trial”. I was only able to cancel the renewal in a year, my card had already been charged and there is no way to cancel or get a refund. I have emailed back and forth several times, with Me+ only being interested in keeping my money. That have not addressed or acknowledged the false advertising of a “free trial”. They have offered me all kinds of discounts and perks to keep this subscription. At this point it’s just the principle of it. I believe my email conversations have been with IA, auto responses or robots and not real humans which has also been not productive and frustrating. Finally they said they wanted to help me process a refund and asked for my receipts, but then they stopped responding. I think it’s a neat concept and app to be fair, but offering a free trial and then charging your card with no option for refund is unethical and needs to be fixed. Do better!!

title: I LOVE THIS APP… with a few exceptions
body:
I’ve always used a paper schedular for everything… but it’s not something I carried around all the time. This app is great for that! 

I love the mood check in, the journal entries, the ability to schedule notifications for certain things and the little bursts of motivation and applause for getting things done. I filled out a survey and it said I was at risk for severe depression (which I know) but the app offered to get me in touch with a therapist. How incredible is that?

And the widget so you can see your list whenever you go on your phone? AMAZING!

However… I cannot justify $75 a year or $13 a month. If it was $50 or under for the year, I would purchase in a heart beat. I think they should offer options as I won’t utilize the entire app (such as the videos and such) they should offer a cheaper version with less features.

Also, a huge negative was that you can’t just take something on your list and move it over to the next day. You also can’t check off things you put on your list for future dates which is crummy because if you happen to get something done early it’s nice to be able to check it off. I’m not sure why that’s not an option? 

Anyways, great app. A bit too pricey for me and I assume for the majority of people this app would be great for - students.

title: Love it! Easy and fun to use. Also helps with ADHD
body:
(Disclaimer: English isn’t my first language)

It is so easy and fun to write down the tasks. The app is very colourful and you can choose different colours for different tasks. The app has a variety of colours that you can choose from. When you write the task, there’s also an emoji at the top. There is a variety of emoji’s you can choose from. As a younger person with ADHD, this app helps me do many productive things during the day. Since I have a different schedule for different days, having separate schedules for each day in the app helps me be less confused on which alarms are for today, contrary to when I use the app that comes with the iPhone. (When I use the one in iPhone I do get confused). I would extremely recommend this app to anyone that has ADHD or a similar situation, and anyone in general that relates to what I said about getting confused with the alarms.

title: Like the app, deeply annoyed by the grammar errors
body:
I love the aesthetics of this app, and the tools it provides, overall, it’s great. However, I am a bit annoyed over the sheer multitude of grammar errors all throughout the app, especially during the on-boarding questionnaire and I’m surprised I haven't come across a review mentioning this. 

The app itself, in terms of functionality, is great, but I really hope the creators fix this grammar problem because it makes the experience feel unprofessional.

I’ve seen:
- Random capitalization
- Spelling errors
- Incorrect use of tenses
- Confusing severity scales (i.e using the phrase “several days” as the next option after “not at all” and following it by “half the days” which just makes no sense at all and doesnt even follow the format of the question)

Overall, I get the impression that this app was written by a non-native English speaker, which isn’t an issue aside from the fact that it was published with all of these errors

title: Paid for the year for a glorified checklist? (False Advertisement)
body:
When I first downloaded the app, it was quite helpful when it suggested stretches for my morning routine. It appeared to be more helpful than it actually was. Now that I’ve been using it for a few days, I’m realizing that this is just a checklist with reminders. The explore page is overwhelmingly bland and unappealing, the daily checklists and reminders you can totally just do on your phone. The appeal of this app is that it helps you with these tasks but instead it just gives you the task and advertises its other apps every other time you check off a task. Before you ask, yes, I have the JustFit app as well, the issue is there’s no search option for both and I find myself scrolling for things that should be easy to find: Stretches, more disability inclusive workouts.

I digress, this specific app clutters itself up. If you have ADHD like me and get overwhelmed quick by disorganized lists(because the way they do organize the tasks like morning routines and healthy lifestyle is NOT helpful) than please just sit down with yourself and create your own list(maybe off pinterest for inspo) and DON’T pay for this app! Create a plan that works for you, that catches your own attention, and don’t rely on this app to get you far on habit building.

Don’t pay for this service, it’s exploiting people with ADHD, people with burnout, and first time mothers. It’s ripping you off when you’re already trying to help yourself and you don’t deserve that 🩵

If anyone reads this, take care, and I hope you find something that works for you.

title: Instant charge up-front disguised as free trial
body:
This is a cute app and I would like it, but as others have commented, selecting a free trial will just instantly charge you for $18.99, as opposed to charging you when the “trial period” ends like most free-trial apps. It charges you upfront meaning you have to take up any complaints / payment corrections with your credit card company or Apple, which is a huge hassle.

If they turned off the instant payment and honoured an actual 7-day free trial before issuing payment, it would give users a chance to try it (or cancel it) without being annoyed. 

It’s a shame because it’s a cute app and I like it, but it feels scammy to charge up front when its advertised as a free trial.

Oh and having to go through the whole nonsense ‘science’ backed on-boarding process only to instantly be met with “pay me now” is off putting to say the least.

title: It’s okay but can’t fully customize to my needs
body:
I decided to just buy premium because $25/year wasn’t too bad. I love that I can colour code tasks, as well as add my own and customize tasks. But I do wish I could add tasks for just one day, and not have that repeat. As well as to be able to delete one task, especially a repeating task for one day if something comes up and changes my plans for the day, and not have that impact anything else or for other days.

My work schedule is unfortunately very inconsistent for days worked and days off. My days off are never the same for each week and that makes it hard for me, someone who needs predictable stability, to form consistent patterns and habits, which is why I downloaded and purchased this app. But finding out I can’t set my chores and tasks for my one day off and not have that repeat for each following day is a little disappointing and makes me feel less inclined to use this app. 

I did pay for the year so I will mess around with this app more and become more familiar with it as it’s just been a few days since I’ve had this app. But I do wish I could add/remove tasks for just one day without it repeating. I hope y’all implement a feature for that in the near future. 🖤💙💚

title: Good but needs work
body: Had the free trial been a bit longer than seven days, I wouldn’t have purchased. I feel like with some development tweaks this app could be amazing. For instance, it always defaults to the first day you started the app when you go to check your sleep sounds. So you always have to go to the drop-down menu to the current date. In the feed where it shows daily information, it cuts off. For instance for horoscope, it will display two sentences and then you can tell there was more but there’s no way to expand. I wish there was an option to have a gradual alarm, instead of a blast right from the start. I’ve since turned the alarm off and just use my iPad. Finally, I am not seeing the same features that are advertised through Instagram on this actual app. There’s supposed to be a way to prioritize my routine based on Myers Briggs? Again, I wouldn’t have paid the yearly subscription had I had a bit longer to trial this. I suggest really using the app before deciding to purchase, as I think it’s overpriced for what it offers and the app feels like it’s in beta mode tbh.

title: Cobran aún anulando la suscripción
body:
Por favor lean los comentarios antes de suscribirse.
Instale esta aplicación , me suscribí a la prueba gratuita para poder probarla, la cual al verla no me gusto ya que no era lo que buscaba, cancelé (anulé) la suscripción y la desinstale de mi teléfono antes de que terminara la prueba gratis.
Por lo que me confié y no revisé las suscripciones.
 Y al mes siguiente me estaban cobrando los 14.990 (pesos chilenos) que sale la aplicación.
Siendo que ya había anulado la suscripción y desinstale la aplicación.
Me dejaron un mes adeudado!
Pagué el mes que debía, y cancelé nuevamente la suscripción para que no siguieran cobrando, ya que no la uso, y la desinstalé.
Pero me lo tomaron como un mes nuevo!! Me lo cobraron, pero no para cancelar la deuda, si no como un mes más.
Por lo que la deuda sigue estando activa, y para colmo me seguirán cobrando así como vamos el mes que sigue.
Pagar 14.990 es mucho, aún más que cancelé la suscripción.
Y debido que hay un monto adeudado, no se pueden instalar más aplicaciones, ya que al quedar una deuda “bloquean” por si decir la tarjeta, y al momento de instalar otra aplicación donde te piden tarjeta, no deja.
Decepcionada, no quiero esta aplicación ni cancelar algo que ni siquiera uso ni tengo instalado.
Realmente piensen si la quieren instalar y espero no acepten los días gratuitos ya que pueden seguirles cobrando.
Le daría 0 estrellas.
Espero recibir una solución.

title: No me gustó
body: Tengo TDAH desde niña (actualmente tengo 35 años) y siempre estoy buscando herramientas que me permitan organizarme mejor, y en un inicio esta me apreció ideal. Pero es lo mismo que llevar la agenda de Google, pero con una gráfica más linda, además que te hacen un millón de preguntas, para que luego tengas que cargar una a una cada actividad de día, considerando también que llevas aparte tu propia agenda, se transforma en un trabajo duplicado, donde marcas cuando lo hiciste. Es una estrategia muy básica, y que termina siempre un gran trabajo extra, ya que para crear cada actividad, hay que configurar un montos de opciones, que el icono, el nombre, la clasificación, la duración, el día, el color del fondo y mil cosas más. Sería de más ayuda si viniesen rutinas predefinidas, básicas, y que las vayas cumpliendo poco a poco, día a día, incrementando tu sensación de logro, y que las que no correspondan a tu perfil (que eso lo armen con las miles de preguntas iniciales) luego te den la posibilidad de marcar lo que te sirve y lo que no, pero eso de armar todo, tú solo, desde un inicio, es una locura, es impresionante la cantidad de actitudes que uno puede realizar durante el día, me pareció nefasto, y sin sentido. Seguiré buscando una app que algún día logre diseñar lo que busco. Y bueno, si alguien se interesa en contactarme e iniciar este proyecto, me sumo como paciente TDAH, puesto somos muchos y necesitamos de una herramienta que nos logre dar lo que necesitamos para disminuir nuestra sintomatología cuando nos agudizamos. Saludos!

title: Se ve bien pero no tiene español

Es pagasa y tiene una prueba de 7 días.

Hasta ahora lo que he visto a mejorar:

- Agregar idioma español.
- Que las tareas tengan horarios.
- Falta cuanto tiempo libre te queda.
- Que los iconos estén organizados por categorías.
- Buscador de iconos (muy frustrante encontrar el que necesitas)
- Poder editar el título y texto a las tareas que son template

title: Reseña
body:
Actualización 2 julio: llevo vario tiempo usando pero tuve qu3 desinstalar la app y volverla a instalar ya que no me dejaba hacer modificaciones, efectivamente al iniciar se perdieron todos mis datos, porfavor agreguen usuarios para poder conservar los datos en la nube 

Actualización con una solicitud: Podrían agregar que una tarea también pueda hacerte varias veces a día para no tener que volverla a copiar? ... ❤️ La estoy usando y es muy útil… pero la actualización no me ha gustado. Es fenomenal la parte del lenguaje, pero no me gustó el echo de que cuando hay una tarea que se hace dos veces entonces le quitaron la interacción de ir sumando cada vez que hacía esa tarea hasta completarla, también quitaron el cronómetro de tiempo, me gustaba mucho, quería recomendar dejar estas cosas, eso es lo que lo hacía diferente de poner mis tareas en un check de notas....lo del tiempo Sinembargo si necesitaba un ajuste como por ejemplo que pudiera seguir funcionando a pesar de entrar en otra app, también me parecería muy útil que pudieran agregar un calendario ya que muchas veces uno no puede hacer lo mismo a las mismas horas todos los días así se permite organizar un poco. Y por último, que con el usuario de uno pueda abrirse en otro dispositivo ya con las actividades guardadas. Ya que si hay un formateo se pierde todo.

title: Ruleta
body:
Lo que quiero decir es que: 
1. La ruleta me pareció una idea genial, ya que rompe con la rutina y lo hace menos aburrido, me emocioné por un momento pero cuando ví que no eran tareas modificables ya no me gustó porque lo que ustedes pusieron no son tareas que todos hacemos por igual. 
2. Las tareas que se veían en el calendario que se presenta arriba de la sesión rutina ahora sale sin ninguna anotación, lo que lo hace inútil porque uno debe ir día por día a ver que se quedó pendiente en días anteriores o que hay planificado para la próxima semana. Ver ese panorama ayuda a planificar el día sin tanto costo. La opción que tenía antes me parecía mejor pensada. No sé que otra cosa necesitan saber. 

Copio mensaje anterior como referencia de mi segundo aporte: 

Hace poco incluyeron algunas funciones, me parece bien el registro “Diario” de reflexiones pero esa ruleta me parece bastante inútil. Hubiera sido más útil si uno la hubiera podido modificar porque no todas esas actividades se acoplan a lo que uno hace en realidad. Debo agregar que noté que quitaron la posibilidad de ver las tareas que uno ya había ingresado en el calendario que se tiene arriba en la sección de rutina, eso me parecía muy útil porque uno podía ver que se había hecho, que no y que tareas habían en las siguientes semanas sin tener que ir día por día o tarea por tarea en la sección de “gestión de tareas”. Uno lo veía como un panorama más amplio. 💔

title: Beste App Ever
body:
Ich liebe diese App wirklich! Me+ hat mein Leben unglaublich erleichtert und mir geholfen, einen gesunden Lebensstil zu führen. Besonders schätze ich die vielen Funktionen, die es mir ermöglichen, meine Aktivitäten und Gewohnheiten zu verfolgen, was mir hilft, auf Kurs zu bleiben und meine Gesundheitsziele zu erreichen.

Die App ist so benutzerfreundlich und gut strukturiert, dass es wirklich Spaß macht, sie zu benutzen. Sie bietet eine klare Übersicht über tägliche Ziele und Fortschritte, was unglaublich motivierend ist. Es fühlt sich fast wie ein personalisierter Gesundheitscoach an, der immer da ist, um mich zu unterstützen.

Dank Me+ hat sich mein Leben extrem positiv verändert. Ich habe viel mehr Klarheit darüber, wie ich mich gesund ernähre und wie ich meine Fitnessziele am besten erreichen kann. Es hilft mir nicht nur dabei, aktiv zu bleiben, sondern auch dabei, mich wirklich mit meinen Gewohnheiten auseinanderzusetzen und sie zu verbessern.

Was ich mir wirklich wünschen würde, ist, dass Me+ auch einen Mahlzeiten-Tracker hinzufügt. Es wäre so hilfreich, wenn ich alles, was ich esse, direkt in die App eingeben könnte, damit ich besser nachvollziehen kann, wie meine Ernährung meine Gesundheitsziele beeinflusst. Es würde die App noch umfassender machen und mir helfen, meine Fortschritte auf noch mehr Ebenen zu verfolgen.

Insgesamt ist Me+ die beste App, die ich jemals genutzt habe, und ich kann sie jedem empfehlen, der sich um seine Gesundheit kümmert!

title: Wenig Weiterentwicklung
body:
Ich habe bereits häufig dem Team von Everjoy geschrieben, dass wichtige Funktionen fehlen, insbesondere für Berufstätige mit Schichtarbeit. Es ist nicht möglich, zwei mal wöchentlich Sport (unabhängig vom Wochentag) als Aufgabe einzutragen, stattdessen muss man sich für einen/ zwei bestimmte Wochentage entscheiden. Als jemand der in Schichten arbeitet, ist diese App daher nicht nutzbar. Die Weiterentwicklungen, die umgesetzt werden, sind ziemlich unnütz. Generell wurde die App im letzten Jahr in ihren Basisfunktionen kaum weiterentwickelt. Ich hatte den Plus Plan und habe diesen wieder gekündigt. Schade

Edit/ Antwort:
Ich habe Ihnen im letzten Jahr mehrfach meine Anregungen per E-mail mitgeteilt - nichts ist passiert.

title: Teilaufgaben nicht zuendegedacht
body:
Die App ist leider sinnlos ohne die Funktion, dass ich mich bei einer wiederholenden Aufgabe bei den Teil Aufgaben entscheiden können, ob ich diese auch in den wiederkehrenden Aufgaben haben möchte oder nur in der aktuellen. 
Beispiel: Wiederkehrende Aufgabe täglich arbeiten von acht bis 12:00 Uhr. Nun habe ich aber zum Beispiel am Montag Aufgabe A zu erledigen am Dienstag, Aufgabe B und so weiter. Das kann man super unter den Teil Aufgaben als To-do auflisten und abhaken. Das Problem ist nur, dass ich diese To-do Liste für alle zukünftigen Tage übernehmen muss. Aber ich hab ja jeden Tag eine andere To-do Liste. Es kommt nur die Frage „für zukünftige Aufgaben speichern“ Oder abbrechen. Warum kann man nicht noch „nur für diese Aufgabe speichern“. Was ja total logisch wäre. Also ich weiß nicht ob die Entwickler sich irgendwas gedacht haben. Wenn diese eine Funktion hinzugefügt wird, dann ist diese App fantastisch. Und wenn sie dann noch mit dem Kalender kompatibel wäre. Dann hätte sie fünf Sterne verdient.

title: Gutes Grundgerüst, aber noch ausbaufähig!
body:
Ich bin ein Fan von Struktur und die App ist sehr süß gestaltet. Alles lässt sich gut notieren, strukturieren und umgestalten wie man es möchte. 😊👍

Doch leider sind auf Deutsch einige Tippfehler vorhanden. Darüber hinaus fände ich es gut, wenn sich die erledigten Aufgaben, von noch zu erledigenden Aufgaben trennen würden, durch ausblenden oder aber durch automatisches „nach unten verschieben“ in einen Bereich für „schon erledigt“ 🧐 damit im Widget auch nur noch die Aufgaben angezeigt werden würden, die man noch vor sich hat.

Apropos Widget. Nützlich wäre auch, wenn man dort auch die Aufgaben abhaken könnte, ohne immer direkt in die App zu müssen.

Mein innerer Monk würde auch gern die oberen Reiter mit den verschiedenen Bereichen verschieben/sortieren wollen.

Gut wäre auch, wenn die Teilaufgaben dauerhaft sichtbar sind, bzw angezeigt werden würde, dass es welche gibt, und wenn vorhanden, die Hauptaufgabe erst abschließbar ist, wenn man die Teilaufgaben erledigt hat. Wenn man einen Zeitraum angibt, während man eine Aufgabe erstellt, wäre es schön, wenn die Aufgaben sich dementsprechend automatisch einsortieren würden und man müsse sie nicht noch extra an die passende Stelle schieben.

Ordnung in den Emojis wäre auch gut. Sie sind zwar grob sortiert, aber innerhalb der Gruppen wild durcheinander. Praktisch wäre, wenn man durch Halten des Emojis einfach das Geschlecht ändern könnte. 

Eine Möglichkeit, seine Aufgaben auf der Applewatch anzeigen zu lassen wäre auch gut.

Dafür, dass man so viel Geld für die App bezahlt, fehlt doch einiges und es ist wie oben beschrieben, noch einiges ausbaufähig. Das Grundgerüst gefällt mir wirklich gut. Doch perfekt ist diese App in meinen Augen noch lange nicht.

title: Super App
body:
Nachdem ich die Kommentare gelesen habe, wollte ich mich auch mal zu Wort melden.
Am Anfang beantwortest man ein paar Fragen, dann wird man zum Abomodell weitergeleitet, welches ich aber mit x abbrechen könnte. Demnach nutzen ich die App seit fast drei Tagen als Standart. Es gibt eine Werbebanner über den Task, genauso wie täglichen Drehungrn, wo man 50% bekommt. Nicht unbedingt toll, aber verstandlich und weniger nervig als bei anderen Apps. 
Leider er kenne ich nicht so wirklich, wie viel mehr man freisvhalten kann, wenn man das Abo abschliest. Ich hatte bisher kaum Beschränkungen in der Nutzung (nutzen Hauptsache ich die Tasks). 
Das einzige Negativ was mir aufgefallen ist, dass man die Task zwar verschieben kann, aber ganz komisch nur für den einen Tag. Ich habe manche Task abwechselt an verschiedene Tagen, aber wenn ich sie an einem Tag richtig hinschiebe, ändert sich die Ordnung am anderen Tag wieder. Was schade ist, weil ich so die Reihe Folge auch im Widget (das sehr gelungen ist) nicht richtig angezeigt bekomme, obwohl es ja sogar die abgeharkten Tasks aus der Reihe nimmt und das nächste anzeigt. Total nutzloch und super. 
Und ja, aktuell gibt es die App nicht auf deutsch. Aber nachdem die Beschreibung auch komplett auf englisch ist (oder zumindest bei mir),bzw. Inzwischen auch schon am Anfang gewarnt wird, dass es nur in bestimmten Sprache nutzbar ist, verstehe ich nicht ganz warum es so ein großes Thema in den Kommentaren ist.

title: Gut gestaltete App

Außerdem fände ich es schön, wenn die Option zum Einmalkauf bestünde, wie bspw. bei der App ‘Structured’, da ich als Studentin nicht über das Geld verfüge, jeden Monat an die 10€ für verschiedene Dienste auszugeben.

- Basic features fehlen (z.B. Anordnungsmöglichkeiten und priorisierungen was genau angezeigt wird)

body:

Ich finde das Design und die Funktionen einfach super schön gemacht und hoffe einfach und es motiviert mich schon sehr meinen Plan für unterschiedliche Dinge zu gestalten! title: Good app but could be better
body:
Its a good app but I’m not sure it’s worth the money. It should be a lot more customizable for that price. 
It’s very frustrating that you can’t add your mood to a day if it’s after midnight. You should be able to click on a specific date on the mood calendar to add your mood if forgotten throughout the day. There should also be way more options when choosing keywords to describe your mood. 
Also there isn’t enough personalization in the habits. If you only want to do a habit once a week you have to add it to a specific day otherwise it will show up every day, that doesn’t allow for flexibility in your routine and it hurts your habit rates. Besides this it would be great if you could see how far you are with a habit. So if you want to drink 8 glasses of water a day but only drink 5, it should say on the overview of all habits (on that specific habit) 5/8, that would be way more motivating. You should also be able to both add time as in how many minutes for a task and times as in how many times a day.
Lastly it’s annoying that you can’t add tags to your habit when you’re creating it instead you have to do that after the habit is created.

title: Sugerencias para actualizaciones futuras
body:
Esta app me encanta, considero que es demasiado útil, pero podría mejorar en: 
1. Poder agendar eventos y aparezca junto con la rutina. Por Ejemplo: “hoy es el cumpleaños de mamá”

2. Poder poner una nota y una foto después de completar una tarea. Por ejemplo: la tarea de “desayunar” quiera poder escribir cuántas calorías y macronutrientes tenía mi plato y poner una foto de él.  

3. Diario personal: tener un espacio en donde hacer anotaciones, planificarme o simplemente dejar una nota relacionada con ese día y poder volver a esa fecha en el calendario y ver lo que escribí. 

4. Demasiadas notificaciones! Solo recibir recordatorios importantes o poder configurar que  tipo de notificaciones quiero recibir. Por ejemplo: notificaciones de ingesta de agua, notificaciones de la app y notificaciones de los recordatorios de tareas. 
Ojalá y estas mejoras puedan ser tomadas en cuenta y aplicadas.

title: Ojalá tuviera una vista mensual
body: La app es muy bonita estéticamente y ayuda en las rutinas diarias, pero me gustaría que hubiera una vista mensual para ver todas las tareas del mes y si las he colocado correctamente. También me gustaría que se pudieran mover las tareas de un día a otro sin que eso afecte a su repetición. Por ejemplo. Tengo programado cada martes ir al gimnasio pero esta semana no puedo, entonces estaría bien poder mover solo esa tarea de ese día en concreto y que eso no afectara a la repetición (como hace el calendario de Apple, que pregunta si deseas modificar solo ese evento en concreto o todos los siguientes). title: Good but…
body:
I like the way the app works with the routines and trying to keep to it. But there are some points that could use some attention. Adding a routine, I would like to add some routines for the future, for when the kids go back to school, but once you add a routine, it puts in on your calendar right away you can choose an end date but no start date. Also if you put a routine on the wrong day you can’t edit it until it is that day! So I can’t edit a routine that’s on schedule for tomorrow, although it was meant for today. 
And I really hate I can’t change the calendar to start on Monday!

Bonjour, cette application ne permet pas juste de faire des routine, elle permet de t’améliorer , tu peux écrire dans un journal quotidien, des défis, des rappels pour boire de l’eau, des alarmes, ds sons relaxants, des conseils, un suivit humeur pour voir comment tu vas, et si ton état s’améliore

title: Manque une OPTION ESSENTIELLE pour les horaires décalés!
body:
Il faut VRAIMENT ajouter une option ESSENTIELLE : pouvoir interagir avec le jour précédent ou suivant (valider, ajouter des unités, modifier).
Pour les personnes en horaires décalés – par exemple quand une “journée de samedi” se termine le dimanche matin – on ne peut plus cocher ce qu’on a réellement fait, et on est obligés de valider sur le mauvais jour.

C’est aussi un problème pour les habitudes qui se font sur plusieurs jours avec un total d’unités (ex : 20 minutes réparties sur 2 jours, mais pas forcément à parts égales). L’app ne permet pas d’ajouter des unités sur le jour nécessaire, ce qui fausse les données, les corrélations et l’utilisation générale.

Il faut absolument une option permettant d’activer/désactiver la modification du jour précédent ou suivant.
Sans ça, c’est très compliqué pour les utilisateurs en horaires décalés, et ça n’encourage pas à prendre la version payante!!

À part ça, j’aime beaucoup cette app!! Mais étant travailleuse de nuit, j’espère que le problème de devoir cocher de force à un jour qui n’est « pas celui dans lequel je suis moi » ne va pas me gêner, car sinon je risquerai de me tourner vers une autre application.

body:
L’UX est vraiment doux, c’est facile de planifier des emplois du temps surtout concernant les tâches récurrentes (surtout quand il y a garde alternée). L’IA de cette appli est vraiment cool pour programmer à partir de programme trouver sur internet/photo. 

J’attends de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour renouveler mon abonnement l’année prochaine. L’idéal serait de pouvoir partager son calendrier avec un conjoint / enfant ! Je trouve aussi que la partie inspiration est vraiment réduite, j’aurai adoré avoir + de routines / d’inspirations / de templates / modèles !

title: Loin d’être au point
body: L’application est esthétique, ça on ne peut pas lui enlever. Sauf que les emojis ne sont pas organiser. On ne peut pas les retrouver via la barre de recherche puisqu’elle est optimisée seulement dans la langue de création de l’appli. L’application est majoritairement vide, il n’y a rien de plus que dans n’importe qu’elle autre calendrier basique. Si quelqu’un cherche une appli efficace et complète, (même si peu esthétique) je vous conseille Structured. Vous avez le temps qu’il reste avant la prochaine tâche, vous pouvez dupliquer les tâches à l’infini et l’application en elle même est bien plus fluide. Vous pouvez mettre autant de sous tâche que vous voulez. Si vous chercher une appli ultra complète qui fasse bien plus que calendrier et qui soit dans le développement personnel, je vous conseille Brite. Vous pouvez y renseigner vos projets, idées, remarque, humeur, il y a des citations, un traqueur d’habitude, Pomodoro, etc.. Après de multiples essaie d’appli ces deux là restes les meilleurs.

title: Nul 65€ dans le vent
body:
Programmer une tâche prend trop longtemps surtout si vous voulez mettre une plage horaire, c’est l’enfer. Du coup mon cerveau de TDAH se désintéresse et bien souvent je reviens deux heures plus tard pour voir que la tâche est toujours en attente de programmation. Et même quand je réussis à programmer la tâche, la sonnerie du rappel est un petit pépiement inaudible. Le résultat c’est qu’au bout d’un moment je m’aperçois que les taches se sont accumulées et ça me décourage encore plus.
Donc 65€ payés pour rien, on en est revenu à la bonne vieille méthode de la feuille de papier sur laquelle on planifie sa journée et posée sur la table pour pas oublier, beaucoup plus efficace.

title: What about eating disorder ?
body:
This app offers self care and mental health advice for depression, anxiety and TDAH. 
But at the same time, it supports diet culture and unattainable beauty standards with weight loss programs and diet advice that aim to help you get the « ideal body » and « look like a Hollywood actress ». There is even advice on « how to suppress hunger ». While some of the advice may be useful for some people, the way it is expressed is wrong because it is often very simplistic and it makes achieving beauty standards a priority. 
This is NOT HEALTHY. I DO NOT RECOMMEND this app for anyone suffering from an eating disorder.
You’d think in 2024 there is no need anymore to explain that working out motivation should be feeling energised, good and healthy, and not looking like a « Tik tok influencer ». (Kind of weird also to be referring to tik tok on a mental health and productivity app don’t you think ??). You’d think there is no need to say that beauty standards such as « flat stomach », « hourglass figure », « filled boobs » and « peachy butt » simply is NOT achievable for all women because we all have different bodies that work differently. Saying otherwise and giving people false hopes is dangerous and can lead to obsession and eating disorders !
This is especially disappointing coming from an app that give mental health advice.

title: Incroyable
body: J’avais jamais rien noté mais là c’est trop, l’app fait tout le contraire de ce qu’elle propose dès son installation. On l’ouvre et hop ça commence par quelques diapo à passer où l’appli se jette elle-même des fleurs (bon c’est l’intro ça reste acceptable) puis on a droit à un « questionnaire » qui fait office d’analyse de la personnalité, le tout dans une ambiance un peu chelou à coup « t’es nul mais on va te rendre meilleur » sur lesquels il faut cliquer à répétition. Puis enfin l’appli se jette à nouveau des fleurs, puis elle vous propose trois formules payantes, quelques secondes plus tard une salvatrice promotion tombe du ciel (-50% sur la formule 1 an, disponible seulement 3h !!!!) puis quand vous avez trouvé la petite croix en gris sur noir enclavée dans le coin de l’écran vous pouvez enfin vous lancer dans l’organisation de vos tâches… ah bh non, d’abord une autre page pour vous proposer de… payer. Juste après avoir refusé de… payer. C’est trop pour moi. Et ça atteint presque les 5 étoiles… on dirait un mauvais jeu mobile, le jeu en moins.

title: Possibilité d’ameliorer encore cette app incroyable ?
body:
Application incroyable ! Efficacité +++

Par contre y’aura-t’il des améliorations prévues (mises a jour) ? 

Quelques idées :
-lorsqu’une activité est crée, est ce que les heures peuvent s’accorder automatiquement chronologiquement dans la journée. Ex : activité 17-18h sera plus en bas de page qu’en premier. 
-impossibilité si je veux creer une activité du 16/01 23h jusqu’a 00h (passage au 17/01) je dois mettre pour l’instant 23:59 
- lors de la creation d’une activité, nous pouvons changer l’icone/logo en haut, mais serait-il possible d’enregistrer les derniers logos/icônes utilisés, ce qui permet d’éviter de chercher tout en bas de page
-lors de la création d’une activité, nous pouvons changer de logo icône mais serait-il possible d’ajouter une propre photo personnelle ou son propre logo d’entreprise par exemple ? 

Voici mon premier retour. Mise a part ça, appli top !!!

title: Great idea ; can be made better
body:
Love the principle of having alarm, sleep tracker/smart alarm, morning routines, positive affirmations, and sleep aids in the same app. 
However here are a few suggestions for growing the app even better (especially since we’re paying) :
- Please allow us to see daily broadcast and deactivate voiceover. I need to know today’s weather in the morning but my sleepy partner doesn’t need to hear it. 
- Please allow us to enter our own morning routine items ! Would be very nice. Even though there already are great options. 
- I would like to know the exact time at which I fell asleep, using the sleep tracker 
- Finally, the possibility of creating an account / backing up to the cloud would be nice. I accidentally deleted the app and lost all the data so I had to re plan my alarms and routines and lost the sleep stats. 

Overall I want to be encouraging, I’m glad I discovered your app !

title: Life saver
body:
I’ve struggled with recurring mental health issues, chronic pain, and chronic gastritis for 5 years now, which initially debilitated me, left me not taking care of myself, not having any routine, never brushing my teeth, never doing the bare minimum and always being stressed by school and homework. I downloaded this about 4 years ago, and it changed everything. It pulled me out of depression twice, helped me get into a rhythm of the bare minimum, I started showering more than once a week and brushing my teeth everyday, and taking my meds. It helped me see what I had to do when my mind and body failed me, and despite me not being perfect everyday, it has 100% made a difference. I’ve gone from showering every week or so, not brushing my teeth, not moving from my bed, to getting up early every day, brushing my teeth everyday, showering every other day, moving around, working, and even exercising a little bit. I’m a completely different person for better, I’m so much happier and this app has been a pivotal factor in my improvements in my health. 

Safe to say I highly recommend, but the key is not to rush perfection. It takes 28 days to change neural pathways and build habits, consistency is key, compassion is necessary. It works wonders.

title: To-Do List, Habits, Life Management
body:
Love this app, use it as a widget on my iPhone. To do lists are great, helps me stay on track so much. Love that you can see the monthly/ongoing overview for each habit so you can see how many days of the month you completed it easily. It’s really helped me with my life and it’s so good to have a portable to do list instead of keeping a million phone notes. Really user friendly and not over complicated like a lot of other organisation apps I’ve tried. (I have the paid version).
The only thing that’s annoyed me a little bit has been the inability to add ‘mood tracker’ to your daily routine without it automatically prompting you for an entry (daily) at the first opening of the app. It also adds a banner on the screen with ‘hey dear, how you feeling today…’ as another prompt to make an entry that stays there permanently unless you exit out of it. Personally I find those things a bit frustrating because they reset every day so the options are to either not have the mood tracker in your daily routine at all, or to have those notifications reset every day. It is a relatively minor thing but it does add up to be annoying if you use the app every day which I do. Only other thing coming to mind that would be a fun addition is some customisation options for widgets, like a dark option etc but that’s a SUPER minor thing and I do love the app!

title: Love this app (plus some ideas/complaints)
body:
I love this app. I have ADHD, I have tried hundreds of planner apps. I will never fully stick to a planner, but me+ is the only one I ever come back to after a procrastination hiatus.

I love the visual clarity, I love the level of customization, I love how the app is perfectly functional on the free version only, I love the features that let me track my stats, I love the badge system (bronze, gold, silver) it reminds me that even if I don’t have the motivation to do everything in a day, doing SOMETHING small is still a small win. 

I do have some minor complaints though, I hope the devs see this and implement some quality of life updates. 

Firstly, some tasks let you set a timer goal, I like this feature. My problem is the timer doesn’t work in the background when the app is closed. 

Secondly if I use a timer outwith the app, I can click on the task and pick “mark as complete” but what if I only did 10 mins out of 20. There is no way for me to put that in other than setting the in app timer, keeping the app open babysitting the timer until it hits 10 mins so I can mark stop. I really wish I was able to log manually how many minutes I did without having to use the in app timer.

Thirdly, the water tracker is a great feature, BUT if you accidentally put your water intake higher than what it actually was there’s no way to reduce the number. Sometimes this is motivating to make me reach the goals, other times it’s purely irritating because I forgot to put in yesterday’s water intake and now my stats are inaccurate.

Also, fourthly this is really really minor but worth mentioning. So, I find having an excessive number of reminders overwhelming. Instead of setting reminders on individual tasks, I create my own tasks that function as purely reminders. I set the title of these tasks as something funny but motivating for me. The problem is when the tasks show up as banner notifications on my phone, the title of the notification is usually cut off and the app creates its own body text for the notification. I’d much prefer if the body notification was just what I set the title as.

I love this app and use it all day every day. But there is a MAJOR glitch. 

When deleting or amending a task and selecting ‘Just Future Task’ it deleted all the history as if you have pressed ‘Delete All’.

Not only does it erase all history or the task, it affects your percentage or the previous days and  when using this feature for organising and amending future tasks or events, it will change all of the prior inputs. 

I used the app to schedule in all netball matches at different times on a repeating task, changed the times of the matches each week and when amending the times for ‘Just future task’ it would changed the previous task too. 

Please look into this frequently used feature and try to amend the glitch. 

Thanks.

- making most things free, but having a different version with a few added things that you need to pay for

title: ‘Subscribe’ Popups ruin it
body:
The app itself is fantastic, but every single time — i repeat EVERY time — you open the app, it will try to prompt you to subscribe! 

Every time you try to check off one tiny task, you’ll find these obstructive popups block the whole screen and you’ll need to tap the teeny tiny ‘x’ to close it. I was considering paying too until this simple fact made me decide against it on principle.

You have a great app, why ruin it for the thousands of users who cannot afford another overpriced subscription? Get rid of the stupid pop ups.

title: Odd
body:
Firstly, the entire app is riddled with grammatical and spelling errors, which really makes the experience feel cheap. It reads in the same way a translated manual from Mandarin to English reads when you purchase a dodgy appliance from TikTok or something. 
Secondly, the entire main page is filled with “influencers” who just use Canva to make a to-do list so they can share their @s with you. How is this useful? The Canva thing again makes this very cheaply put together. 
With the above in mind, if you’re charging over £50 annually for a subscription, I’d expect a far more sophisticated service and language use. 
Disappointed.

title: Pretty good! ♡
body: This is a wonderful app, and can definitely sort out your days. Well, unless your in school. What I find troubling, is I seem to always forget to actually go on the app. I may have accidentally clicked for there to be no notifications, but I don’t think there are any. Other than this it’s a lovely app, as someone struggling to be organised, (not like I’m diagnosed with anything mental) this does help a lot. I highly recommend it to anyone with adhd or just struggle focusing, as there are daily affirmations for you to do, meditations, and so much more. Most stuff is free, but if wanted, you can buy premium and unlock a few more things! I especially love the anxiety relief meditation, after a long day of work, as I get headaches and migraines. Doing a simple 5-15 minute Excersise can seriously help you mentally and physically. Making you think more positive, and be more positive. Many children aswell will enjoy this app, it’s not a thing to show off or anything, or to be “minimalistic.” It’s a good idea, especially (I love that word haha) since it’s a day organiser, and you can choose what days certain things happen. For me, it’s school Monday-Friday. I hope the best, and cheers to the developer(s) of this absolutely game-changing app. Thank you for readying this far if you did!

title: Great!!!
body:
Me + is really, really good! It honestly structures my life on a day to day basis and helped me be organised. It motivated me with goals and criteria’s, and visually helped me using widgets and reminders. The mood tracker is great, and helps me put my day into perspective, and the endless quizzes about your life and how you can improve it are really helpful.
However…
The fact that you must buy a premium package to be able to save, edit and print pre-made routines is ridiculous, considering the price.

My suggestion…
Have a tool where you can make your own printables (routines, quotes, affirmation etc) that is completely free! Also, reduce the premium price.

All in all, a great app and I truly think that it helped me get my life in shape! 😊

title: Poorly written AI; nothing like the description
body:
I cannot figure out how this app has nearly five stars—must be bots. 
There are no routines as shown, everything has to be entered basically from scratch. There are templates, but they’re poorly written (seemingly AI generated) and unhelpful. For example, the “Home Cleanliness” routine has five steps, to be performed every day: 1-Clean the bedroom, 2-Clean the wardrobe, 3-Try changing bedroom pattern, 4-Put a pot of green plants (??), and 5-Throw away old clothes. I don’t know about you, but this routine isn’t keeping my house tidy for sure. “Keep my kitchen tidy” includes the super-helpful Tuesday task of “Clean room”. Also, “laundry [sic] the dish towels” and “sanitize the trash bins every day”. 
The 7-day free trial didn’t happen and I was charged immediately. Don’t waste your money. There are WAAAY better options out there.

title: Quite good, but think on saving money.
body:
This app is quite lovely, gives daily reminders to help with problems, but think this. Are we sure we are going to use this?

With many designs, it can be a quick way for people to fix onto this and get attached. This is what causes people to believe that it could work out and so buys the subscriptions.

On IPhone, IPod touch and many Apple phones, there are reminders that serve the same purpose, without the hassle of seeing many needs to plunge your money into an app with the same needs, but just added colour.
You can make this in real life! For only a few pounds you could get some paper and pens to decorate to your liking. It may be free, but the advertising may get to us.
So when you scroll through YouTube shorts and see this, just think of the many ways to avoid this money-grabbing app.
author: The Big Mahmee

title: Appreciate the concept but work is required on UX
body:
I’m a mum to one toddler (and a boyfriend to clean up after), working full time, about to start studying and so helped this app would be perfect for me trying to manage it all with my incredibly overwhelmed ADHD head of mine as starting to get burnt out. A lot of the ads I’ve seen are selling aimed at those with an ADHD diagnosis and says backed by science but there’s a couple of things that I think would just not work:
- the way the items displayed are all at once - not great for burnout and overwhelm. It mentions a few times about starting with one task yet shows you them all at once? Really there should be a toggle for the day for morning / afternoon / evening with alternate views to show all. 
- there needs to be better categorisation of tasks so you can see your cleaning, self-care, financial wellbeing, fitness, healthy eating goals better. 
- some of the suggestions for repeated tasks seem unrealistic. Like who takes trash out every day? 

All in all the idea of the app is great but just needs some refining for me to be able to use it. I could effectively just use the reminders app on iPhone if I wanted a big list of stuff.

author: What I think of me +

title: Disappointing
body:
As someone who struggles to organise my time especially in getting cleaning done efficiently…I usually blast through most of it in a day and exhaust myself so a daily, weekly and monthly rota is needed.  I downloaded this app a week ago and was so disappointed to find that it’s s blank; the user needs to input all the data themselves…one of the very things that seems a huge and impossible task for me….so I’m unable to use this huge waste of money that also tries to make me part with more money to buy their other apps.  One good thing that came out of this is that I’ve started writing a list of my tasks on paper to make a rota to stick on my fridge!  
  Come on guys, at least include a list of possible tasks  (other than vacuuming every day and changing sheets once a month WTAF!) My expectation was that there would be a list of tasks and columns of daily, weekly, monthly, bi-yearly, yearly for the user to click the task into the right column and then some blanks so the user can write in their miscellaneous tasks. 
 I think I could actually set reminders on my phone for any tasks anyway. 
By the way, I would appreciate a refund…£13 for a blank sheet (and labelled as “premium VIP”). If there is some other super duper thing that it’s supposed to do, I couldn’t find it.

author: Reviewer Of Games And Things

title: Not free, it’s £12.99 per MONTH (£156 per YEAR) after trial
body:
I was so looking forward to this having read the positive reviews. I have autism, ADHD and OCD so my organisational skills are very poor, no matter how hard I try. I have almost no sense of time due to the ADHD, and when combined with autism and OCD it makes it very difficult to address this. 

I was impressed with what I saw, until the £12.99 monthly fee (£156 per year) appeared. Whilst I understand the need to pay the staff who work hard to keep this app going, that fee is beyond ridiculous, particularly in the current economic climate. I can’t afford to feed myself and my children properly so I already miss meals to address this. Having ADHD and autism is not a lifestyle choice but a biological condition and I feel that making large amounts of money from people who genuinely struggle to cope with every day life due to no fault of their own is immoral, especially since those who are neurodiverse are the most likely to need an app such as this and are the ones who would benefit the most.

I have managed to adapt the new Apple apps which help with tasks, tracking and health to help me instead. It took several hours of my time and that of my youngest son, but we have managed to create something similar to this app across the various Apple ones, and it is FREE.  As my eldest is also autistic and has ADHD, we are trying out those apps together. It required work to set up, and will probably need a lot of tweaking, but hopefully worth it.

Overall it is a very good app for people with adhd and other problems.

title: Mid App, taking advantage of ADHDers.
body:
I’m so glad I didn’t pay the subscription and used the free version, after 10mins it’s evident this app was barely thought about. 

Firstly, after entering some info and setting up, you are presented with a 2min timer and a “limited special offer” to buy a subscription. This I feel takes advantage of people like myself who suffer with ADHD a symptom of this is often having poor impulse control, when presented with a time limited offer, the app tries to capitalise on impulsivity knowing fully that the majority of its patrons are people who struggle with ADHD. They are not looking to help you, they are looking to profit from you. 
As I continue on the app suddenly a spinning roulette wheel comes up, like it would on an Asian shopping site, “congrats you have won the jackpot” 50% limited time. They knock another £10 off of the price and see if they can tempt me once more. Typical.

The app itself has a very poor interface. When setting a goal such as something simple like drinking water, you can change the measurement and value for your goal except it maxes out at 999. So if you wanted to drink more than 999ml of water in a day (there’s no litre option but you can select miles, Km or meters, if you want to drink 3miles of water as you do) then I suggest using something else.

The apps design is minimalist using emoji-esque pictures to accompany bland black and white text. It’s like it’s been made on notes and looks like any other mid tier planning app. The illustrations and guidance from a tutorial only extended to the first setting up of the app, once youre in you’re on your own, and are not given any real direction where to begin. 

Features like taking other people’s weird routines seems pointless and the options you can add are very vague and general. It doesn’t feel very personal and over all could be a much more guided experience. The whole thing seems low quality.

Also apparently they sell your data. 

Overall, it feels silly and like little effort went into this. @ developers if I get a response, I have no desire to email you with more info, your app is poor and I wish you put as much effort into helping people that you do trying to capitalise off of them. I will continue searching for an ADHD friendly planning app but the likelihood is that a good one doesn’t exist. Either way with the “limited time discounted” £17.99 yearly subscription, you should get a lot more. I’m glad I didn’t give in to my impulsiveness, the free version speaks volumes after 5 mins.

title: Good for shifting focus back to self care
body:
So far I have really enjoyed the sleep scoring, puzzle alarm, advice, soundscapes and meditation.
The habit tracker is ok, but is really hard to use if you want to be more flexible. It would be a lot better if you could set a goal of X times in a week rather than have it be a daily task. If I lived alone I might be able to pre-schedule this day is for cleaning, this day I want to do a workout, but I have to work around 4 other people’s routines and friends’ ever changing social timetables. So it’s good for little daily habits, but to track something more time consuming like a workout or getting your house in order, it lacks flexibility in its timetabling and goal setting.
My subscription is half price so for what I paid the other resources make it worth that. But if I paid full price I would be disappointed by the habit tracker part; it’s too rigid for anything other than small daily habits.

title: Brilliant!
body:
In an era driven by technology, finding the perfect app can be a challenge. However, I am delighted to share my 5-star review on the exceptional app called Me+. With its unique features and superb functionality, Me+ has undoubtedly become a top choice for enhancing productivity, staying organized, and promoting personal growth.

Summary:
Me+ is a highly intuitive app that elevates the user's overall experience. Its sleek design and user-friendly interface provide effortless navigation, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey through its features. The app offers a wide range of tools that cater to various needs, from goal setting and habit tracking, to time management and personalized journaling.

Productivity at Its Best:
One of the standout features of Me+ is its ability to boost productivity by structuring tasks efficiently. With the option to create and manage multiple to-do lists, users can prioritize their tasks, set deadlines, and receive reminders. Would definitely recommend.

title: I wanted to love it but it’s not worth it
body:
I wanted to love this app, it is very pretty and has useful features. The reminders and tasks are more on the ‘positive’ side too; ie it tells you to go for a walk because it’s good for your brain etc.

However there is just not enough of the app to make it worth the subscription. There are only about 10 sample schedules with very vague, surface level tasks. Once you have picked the samples you have to create your own which is time consuming.

It also doesn’t remind you automatically or seem to create a schedule of the day which is not just a random list. It doesn’t block rhe tasks into time blocks of how long it will take.

Some of the ‘features’ like healthy foods are just so surface level it feels like a rip off. I know this app is for profit, obviously, but it feels more exploitative for that cost. There just isn’t enough content.

Also It pushes yoga but there is no yoga video.

title: This could work 🤔
body:
I always want to be organised and clean and tidy, plus I want to develop and keep habits that use the stuff I buy, all with good intentions, only to find them still in the box months later!! 🤦‍♀️
I love lists and I’m actually quite motivated by them. 
BUT
My body has deteriorated rapidly and Co existing chronic conditions, pain and brain scrambling medications have robbed me of my ability to stick to paper or self written lists. 
This little App has certainly got off to a great start and having lists to choose from, but still edit to personalise, has been a great way to remember the things I want to do. I really enjoy ticking things off and am eager to add more things. 
The addition of different meditation programs and audible breathing techniques and fitness programs is also really great as everything is in one place. 
I’ve already learnt how to put widgets on my Home Screen with constant reminders and set a few alarms too. This way I’m being gently nudged to build the habits I want to develop and easily add them to my day. 
I’m intrigued as to how long this will last, but I bought the discounted one year package and I’m intending to enjoy and enhance my daily living with tweaks and with new goals.

It has potential and is easy to use and keep track of your activities, but it isn't worth the subscription.

title: AMAZING💕💕
body:
Me+ is a productive app! It has all different types of videos like how to clean ur room without getting overwhelmed or how to medicate during the day. It also gives u some questions at the beginning so the app knows how ur lifestyle is going so it could help u in the future. Ikr smart! It also gives u a contract to sign before u get started! Obviously a fake one but it’s still cool! The contract tells u stuff that u have to do everyday or if u change it to once a week or once a month.It also tells u to be more productive and active. After you’ve read the contract u sign ur signature at the bottom.Theres also premium which u don’t have to get but it makes ur experience better on the app! I personally don’t think u should buy it tho bc the app is still rlly good without it! It makes me soo organised and I luv it! It’s also kinda fun! When I mean kinda fun I mean very fun! Overall I luv me+. If ur parents r looking at the reviews and don’t know if they should get it for their kids, BUY IT! That’s all I’ve got to say abt this amazing app!

title: Me+ master review
body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐️(5/5)

✨ I’ve been using the Me+ app for a while, and I’m really enjoying it! 😊 It helps me stay organized, build good habits, and keep track of my daily goals. 📅✅

The app is easy to use, has a clean and beautiful design 🎨, and the reminders keep me motivated. 💪🌟

The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that some of the best features are locked behind the premium version 💳, and the notifications can sometimes feel a little repetitive. 🔔

Overall, it’s a great app for anyone who wants to improve their daily routine, stay productive, and build positive habits. Highly recommended! 🌱🚀❤️

title: my personal opinion
body: Me+ is an absolutely great app It gives me free workouts. It helps me with my ADHD. I found out i have mental trauma, and also it’s a great help for your daily routines. And it also gives you free relaxing sounds for those days where you just need to have a break. But there are some little downside now I love this app, so what I’m about to say is just the problem that I have with it. there are only three things I don’t like about the app number one, it will ask you for you to pay so that you can have full accessibility for everything. number two how less work are there are There should be like a 15 day workout challenge or like just a one hour full workout or something like that, and the last and final thing I would like to say is that you don’t have an option where you can let you know. Just delete your whole routine I have to do it one by one because sometimes my routine immediately changes because of some big shocking things, so yeah thats it. But overall, it’s a really great app. You should download it. It will help you so much in your life. But I wish they had more studying options or like job options or something like that for relaxation or like helping you with your work or homework or your assignment or something like that download the app you will not regret it 💖✌️😛✌️

That's all, thanks for the app so so much.

title: Really useful!!
body: You can do literally anything with this app. You can set timers (to study, to relax, to read, to clean) or pomodoro method, you can set alarms and customise them (with things like “shake your phone five times” or “13+42” to make your brain wake up), you can keep track of how much water do you drink (the app will send you notifications to remind you to drink) and you can also keep track of your sleep. There are a lot of tips to study, clean, and things like this. There are motivation phrases, soundscapes, things to meditate and workout. Every day, when you open the app, a little sticker come in and ask you how do you feel and similar things. And you can obviously create a routine, and your phone will send you notifications when you have to do that things. It’s really easy to use, and perfect for persons who have ADHD or anxiety.

title: Negative experience for new users
body:
Although it has a free trial, the app will keep spamming you with the paid version and FORCE you to buy it, if not, you will not be able to add routine templates (the ads of paid version will appear every time you click "save" and prevent you from saving the routine to your calendar). I didn't even bother to explore other functions since they already blocked the most basic ones. It was annoying and actually created a negative feeling for me. I don't mind paying for the app if it works well, 2300yen is not that much, but after seeing how the app treated new users, I decided to drop this app. 

The point is, if you offer a free trial, make it a positive experience for new users. What's the point of making a free trial if you block the most basic features? When I first opened the app, the intro was really cute and I was already convinced 80%. Ironically, I deleted the app 15 minutes later.

The app is free with no ads, but if you want to access all of the features, you will eventuly have to pay (new members get a 50% discount so it costs about 20 eur). A like that its like an all in one of every app from this developer - it has so many features:
Routines
Some workouts
Sleep tracking
Water tracking
Mood tracking
Meditations
Reflection
I think thats everything but maybe i forgot something, i dont remember. 🧐 Just that it has so many features! 
Thank you so much me+, you were making my day better from the first time I opened the app! 🥰🥰🥰🫶🫶🫶
I really recommend this app!!!

title: Wenig Mehrwert bei ADHS – Standard-Apps reichen aus
body:
Diese App hat mir persönlich leider nur wenig im Alltag geholfen. Meiner Einschätzung nach lässt sich eine solche Checkliste mit demselben Aufwand auch manuell und analog erstellen.
Ich möchte die Anwendung keineswegs pauschal abwerten. Als jemand, der von ADHS betroffen ist, hatte ich jedoch die Hoffnung, dass diese App einen echten therapeutischen oder strukturellen Mehrwert bietet. Letztendlich erzielt sie bei mir persönlich jedoch exakt denselben Effekt wie die standardmäßig auf jedem iPhone vorinstallierte App „Erinnerungen“ – einen nennenswerten Zusatznutzen konnte ich daher nicht feststellen.

title: Не третье время
body: Сначала вас ждёт заманивающий onboarding, где вы вдохновитесь данным планером, но не дав попользоваться ни одной функцией, вам предлагают оформить платную  подписку. Я хорошо отношусь к платному контенту, но хочу знать за что заплачу, поэтому нажимаю «пропустить» после чего сново onboarding с вопросами и вы подумаете, наконец то, сейчас я попользуюсь и пойму что же это за красивое приложение, но нет! Вам предлагают покрутить колесо фортуны и выиграть скидку на подписку. Выиграв скидку вы не сможете отказаться платить и пользоваться бесплатно так как наткнетесь на 5-6 баннеров о тарифах, позже на баннер о истекающей через 40 секунд скидке на тариф , ну а пропустив и это вам сново предлагают покрутить колесо фортуны. Я понимаю что хочется чтобы проект скорее приносил деньги, но тогда могу посоветовать чтобы не терять пользователей, вместо onboarding историй просто продемонстрируйте видео , как пользуются приложением другие люди. Все красиво, можно было бы поставить больше чем одну звезду если бы не было потрачено столько времени в пустую

title: Nuevas actualizaciones no tan funcionales
body: Creo que la app estaba mejor sin las actualizaciones donde solo puedes marcar las tareas de ese día, creo que no es funcional ya que si quieres adelantar tareas de días futuros no las puedes marcar, igual con las tareas pasadas, si tienes alguna que realizaste pero no la marcaste por cuestión de tiempo, etc, ya no la puedes marcar después. Es una app para ser más organizado, y ahora es 0 funcional porque ahora tienes que organizarte para poder marcar las que realizaste días antes, y no se te bloqueen las tareas. Entiendo que la función de la app es que la gente sea organizada y podrían implementar el que de nuevo se puedan marcar tareas pasadas y futuras tareas y dar puntos, por ejemplo si realizaste la tarea ese día +10 pts, si la marcaste un día después +5 pts y así realizar una dinámica que motive a las personas a realizar sus actividades ese día, permitiendo el poderlas marcar después.

title: Publicidad engañosa, no hay 7 días de prueba.
body:
No es cierto que haya 7 días de prueba. Elegí esa opción para evaluarla por 7 días y se hace el cargo inmediatamente por el año completo sin siquiera haberla probado. No me convenció su contenido pero el cargo por el año completo ya estaba hecho. ¡Cuidado!

 
Misleading advertising!
It's not true that there is a 7-day trial. I chose that option to evaluate it for 7 days and the charge for the full year is made immediately without even having tried it. I was not convinced by its content, but the charge for the full year was already made. Be careful!

title: Good idea but requires more work
body:
The app looks nice and could be a good benefit for its subscribers but currently it’s very limited and not flexible enough.
There are few routines (e.g. 6 for workouts, 3 for studies) that are almost non-adjustable. I wanted to customize my weekly workout routine by replacing aerobics (which I’m not interested in) by tennis etc., however it’s not possible. The only changes you could make is selecting week days and setting goals for this specific activity. As a result instead of using templates you have to make your routines from the very scratch.
I hoped that AI for cleaning routine would be a good basis for creating my own routines but it doesn’t work properly as well. When answering questions I indicated I have no pets but still got “wash pet bowls” task, not to mention several repetitive tasks such as “wash dishes” and “was dirty dishes”, etc. 
Honestly I don’t want to spend a lot of time putting together all the tasks I want to do for a day/week/month from zero. I want the app making part of a job. So for me this app is not that useful, although the idea behind it is good.
